name: 企查查
summary: 查企业工商、风险、知识产权与招投标。
description: 企查查智能体数据平台官方 MCP：按数据域接入工商信息、风险、知识产权、经营、历史、人员、法规、裁判文书、招投标与文档解析。每次连一个域，需要时再切换。
examples: 查「某某科技有限公司」的工商登记和股东信息
这家公司的司法风险和被执行记录有哪些
统计这家公司名下的专利和商标
查一下这个项目的中标记录和招标方

instance.label: 数据域
instance.hint: 每个数据域是独立的 MCP 服务，切换后会断开当前连接并需要重新连接。

help.label: 查看企查查 MCP 接入说明
help.hint: 授权后在浏览器登录企查查账号即可；调用按账号积分计费，需先在平台充值。

en.summary: Look up company registration, risk, IP, and bidding data.
en.description: Official QCC agent data platform MCP: connect business registration, risk, IP, operations, history, people, regulations, court documents, bidding, and document parsing by data domain. Connect one domain at a time and switch when needed.
examples: Look up the registration and shareholders of Example Technology Ltd.
What litigation risk and enforcement records does this company have?
Count the patents and trademarks under this company
Check the winning bid records and buyer for this project
en.name: QCC
